goal: Prevent industry orientation coverage from being mistaken for blind-memory saturation, connect seal readiness to the worker path through an exact-artifact audit, add a bounded sparse exploration frontier, and make the next recall step recoverable without loading campaign history.
baseline_impact: none; this tightens CAP-0006 campaign control without changing Evidence, PIT/no-lookahead, Reality/Judgment/Outcome, provenance, source authority, or sealed-artifact immutability
schema_impact: application/domain control objects plus versioned Git seal-decision and supersession control records; no product database migration
acceptance: An orientation-only campaign or shard cannot pass the seal gate.
Seal eligibility requires three recent low-novelty outcomes from distinct pass families, explicit negative-space review, and an independent challenger review.
Any high-novelty recent pass resets eligibility even when top-level headings are complete.
A sparse bounded frontier chooses one deterministic next probe without materializing a time-by-shard Cartesian product.
reviewed-no-specific-memory remains a research coverage state and is never interpreted as real-world absence or contradiction.
Focused regression tests use the current Banking/Shipping failure shapes without fixing lead counts, ontology size, or prompt wording.
A changed structured seal claim is rejected by worker CI unless one exact-artifact decision recomputes green or one exact append-only supersession reopens it.
